question: What is the name of badge that the user whose display name is "Pierre" obtained?
clarification: Also keep rows that have no matching badges record.
gold: SELECT T2.Name FROM users AS T1 LEFT JOIN badges AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.UserId WHERE T1.DisplayName = 'Pierre'
gold0: SELECT T2.Name FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN badges AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.UserId WHERE T1.DisplayName = 'Pierre'

b.request: What are the names of all badges obtained by the user whose display name is "Pierre", including a row for that user even if they have no matching badges record (i.e., a left join from users to badges)?
b.sql: SELECT b.Name FROM users u LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.Id = b.UserId WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Pierre'

d.request: What is the name of the badge obtained by the user whose display name is "Pierre", and also include rows for users with that display name who have no matching badges record?
d.sql: SELECT b.Name FROM users u LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.Id = b.UserId WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Pierre'
